provenance.label: Hypothetical 30-day scoring example — not the Daily Brief, a user account or connected-provider telemetry

sources.description: Complete invented register of 10 distinct, equally weighted declared AI needs for this period. Nine meet their predefined acceptance criteria; one does not.

Complete invented single-currency period ledger: USD 120 paid; USD 90 allocated once to documented meaningful use. Meaningful means completing a declared need or a documented task, not merely a login. The other USD 30 is unsupported by this scenario's usage evidence, not a proven saving or cancellation recommendation.
Complete invented log of 100 AI requests in the same period: 96 successful, four unsuccessful, no unknown outcomes. Every request, including a retry if present, is counted once.

Complete invented register of five declared critical workflows. Four have a tested, accessible fallback capable of meeting their minimum task requirements under the specified primary-failure scenario; one does not. Another provider account alone does not establish usable fallback.
